scenes.text: You probably think that every single tree on Earth is completely stuck in one spot forever, but deep inside the Ecuadorian rainforest, there is a bizarre species that actually walks.
Known as the walking palm, this mind-bending tree literally grows brand new roots in the direction of sunlight, while its older, rotting roots slowly wither away and die off behind it.
This constant process allows the entire tree to migrate across the forest floor, traveling up to twenty meters every single year just to survive in the dense, dark jungle canopy.
Imagine walking into the woods only to realize the forest is actually shifting around you, so tell me in the comments if you would search for this moving tree.
